notes.title: 1.18 Christmas 2022 Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.18 update in time for the holiday season - this update features a limited-time holiday inspired game mode, along with the introduction of [b]Harmony[/b] and [b]SimulatorFM[/b] stations to the game's radio! Thank you to the community who have provided feedback via livestreams and on our social media channels! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u63zMs9.png[/img]

[h2]Christmas Delivery Game Mode[/h2]
Deliver the Christmas gifts from all the residents of the local town in a fun and relaxed puzzle-style game mode. Find all 14 gifts and deliver each gift to the houses in the snowy-filled town! You can find it from the 'Career Modes' menu from the title screen!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0UkI3lw.png[/img]
[b]Personalise your company name and identity at the start of the game mode to feel at home in your own custom warehouse experience! The logo will be displayed around the warehouse - look out for it![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HTTBYQL.png[/img]
[b]Deliver all the gifts to the town to light up the building decorations![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ncNiY4G.png[/img]
[b]Instead of delivering specific packages, you'll need to find the gift boxes hidden around the warehouse since the Roomba-Bots got mis-programmed and froze down in the snowy temperatures.[/b]

[h3]Update Notes[/h3]
Career
- Added 'Christmas Delivery' game mode, accessible from the title screen

Cosmetics
- Added 'Giftbox', 'Holiday Duck' and 'Snowman' cosmetic hats
- Added 'Harmony' and 'SimulatorFM' cosmetic stickers.

Radio:
-Addition of Harmony Radio.
-Addition of SimulatorFM Radio.
-Removal of Hype station (due to loss of server connection, and no contact/information regarding their shutdown relayed to development team)

Misc:
-Credits updated

notes.title: V1.17 Update - Free Forklift Drivers Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.17 update, which finally includes our brand new in-game characters which we announced a few weeks back. Saint George, Dr Plaster, Minoru, Clover and Maple are ready to drive the forklifts in your arcade gamemode, FREE to play today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/d275d5708fd692e2fc7fb322986832f93ee85fc5.png[/img]

We have also joined forces with our friends at Heartbeatz Radio and Hype Radio, meaning you can now listen to their awesome simulation stations directly in-game (press 'R' to use the radio in-game)!

[h2]Characters[/h2]

[/list]

[*] Addition of Hype Radio.
[/list]

notes.title: 2022 Forklift Drivers Update - Initial Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vfBv4i_WYVw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello forklift drivers!

Today, we are excited to announce the introduction of five new playable character joining the Amazing warehouse team, in an update coming late 2022. Saint George, Dr Plaster, Minoru, Farmer Clover and Chef Maple will be the first set of characters who will be selectable as drivers in the career levels. They will be available to play in an free update planned for September-October after the conclusion of a satisfactory QA phase. A talented cast have joined the development of the game to voice our new characters, with their work set to feature throughout the menus and career levels while driving throughout the in-game days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/7e132ea4ca02454cfab20448acdc33d390477417.png[/img]

[h3]Saint George[/h3]
A masterful and skillful knight, Saint George is a man who led his army of soldiers through a dark and distressing eight year war against the Roman Empire. A man with a leading individual who is faithful to his team, works with pride and honour. Seth Jones brings a strong voice to the character; he has recently featured in the English-dubbed version of Attack On Titan.

[h3]Doctor Plaster, Ph.D[/h3]
Doctor Plaster is your caring, respectful and confident medical practitioner/physician. A well-educated and knowledgeable individual, who provides self-assurance, informative and friendly remarks throughout the gameplay. Matthew Kreta provides Dr Plaster's voice - he has also featured on the fan-made Danganronpa: Despair Time video series and the visual novel Ringo Fortune (Sarchalen Team).


[h3]Minoru[/h3]
Originating from Askahori, Minoru is a quick-minded, responsible and fast-paced individual. His next move is unpredictable; projecting humorous but puzzling quotes to keep the player guessing and learning about him. Alejandro Arias voices this youthful character - he has worked on various internet cartoons and shorts (Cartoon Cafe, Team Teen, Mari & Jouzo) along with appearances in Fate of WINDSHIFT (REAL Co.Ltd) and Dislyte (Lilith Games).


[h3]Farmer Clover[/h3]
An individual from a rural township, Farmer Clover works on her local farm managing her ranches of cows, chickens and horses. She's strong, angry and not afraid to fight for her work. Veronica Laux brings a wealth of experience to the role, voicing characters for various anime shows and visual novels including Aharen-san wa hakarenai (Felix Film), The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody (Comikey), ALLBLACK Phase 1 (NSAID) and Potion Commotion (NerdyBird Studios).


[h3]Chef Maple[/h3]
A proud and confident lead chef in a successful restaurant in her hometown, Maple is an excited and hopeful individual who enjoys showing off her work and is excited to cook and provide a high quality service to her customers. Voiced by Sierra Lipe, who has featured in Danganronpa: Gods at Gunpoint (deimosatellite) and Hyper Custom Night (TheImpossibleMode).

notes.title: 1.16.2 Patch Update - Minor bug fixing and polish

notes.title: 1.16 Update - Multiplayer restored, minor bug fixing
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.16 update, which fixes several bugs noted over the past few weeks! As you may have noticed, our Career Mode has been revamped into an Arcade mode, in preparation for a new career-focused game mode we look to introduce later this spring! More news on that to come! All Arcade Levels are now unlocked, multiplayer servers have been restored, and a general polish up of the menus! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removal of 'Fidget Spinner', 'Guitar' and 'Robin Hood' cosmetic hats, as a result of engine updates.
[*] Cosmetic paintwork, hats and stickers will be exclusive for Arcade Mode.
[/list]

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated user-interfaces for Career, Multiplayer, Rumba-Racing, Garage submenus, and additional UI elements cleaned up in the Main Menu.
[*] Fix for minor bug where cosmetic stickers would not fully clear.
[*] Updated visual layout of Credits screen.
[/list]

[h3]Internal systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgraded engine to Unity 2021.2.4f1.
[*] Transferred to Steamworks.NET 15.0.1 library for improved Steam integration.
[*] Updated rich presence for Discord/Steam integrations.
[*] Updates to internal radio system to run directly in-game instead of an external process.
[*] Addition of SimulatorVibes radio station, and updates to TruckStopRadio and Simuator Radio logos.
[/list]

notes.title: Forking Hell Major Halloween Update - October 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/51e2dbe0523e7a9072c6a883898262fa760ff7bf.png[/img]

I am delighted to announce a major update to Forking Hell which sees the addition of seasonal content, 
new permanent features and the launch of Forking Hell multiplayer.

[h2]Seasonal Content[/h2]

🎃We know Halloween won't be as good this year, so why not go [b]Treat Or Treating[b] in our seasonal game mode, which lets you deliver candy products to the neighbourhood.
🌛[b]Temporary celebrations[/b], to let you work in the Amazing warehouses at night-time for the spookiness of the season.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
👥 Our most requested feature was multiplayer! Now you can hop on a server with your friends or with others in the community to drive around and haul cargo around the local city in an open-world style format.

[h2]Permanent features[/h2]
📷 [b]New camera angles[/b] give you more opportunities to look around the warehouses while sitting in your vehicle!
📻 [b]Add custom radio stations[/b] to listen to any internet radio stations within your local game! Simply add your favourite station name and URLs to the txt file in your Documents and load up the game to listen directly in-game!
📃Squad up in [b]Forking Hell Clubs[/b] - your chance to group up and join a virtual warehouse company to share stats and play together!
🎮[b]Keyboard keybindings[/b] allow you to change the default keyboard and mouse input to personalise your in-game experience. Controller and other gamepad inputs will not fully work for now, but we will continue to work towards this.
🎨 [b]New garage additions[/b] let you customise your forklift vehicle even more - change the colour, add cosmetic stickers or alter the vehicle's horn.

📞

notes.title: Radios Update - July 2020
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the arrival of five enjoyable and high quality internet radio stations, which are live to listen to during your forklift career!

To listen to any of our radio stations, load up any career level and press the [u]Radio key[/u] (R on keyboard, X on Xbox controller).

[h3]Introducing our radio line-up[/h3]
British based radio [b]Bounce[/b] founded in 2020 are in the final stages of their setup, and approached our development team earlier this month regarding involvement. We are delighted to help provide listeners for this recently-founded team!

[b]Hive365[/b] are recognised for their involvement of community servers of Counter-Strike, Left 4 Dead, Team Fortress 2, GMod and Minecraft. We are proud to feature their radio station which celebrated their seventh anniversary in 2020 and continue to rise in the gaming community.

Founded in April 2020, [b]SimulatorHits[/b] supply a variety of music on-air with focus on the simulation genre of games. We are excited to join up with their community. 

[b]Simulator Radio[/b] initially approached our development team prior to Forking Hell's release. Originally opening in 2014 under the name EuroTruckRadio, they have expanded into a large gaming community with a combined social media backing of over 15k followers. Without their support, the radio feature would not have been possible! The radio was always in the game, but this is our chance to introduce their community and thank them for their support.

[b]Truck Stop Radio[/b] is a fully community-ran online radio station also aimed at the simulation community with their launch in May of 2020 - it's great to work with you guys, also!

[h3]Update notes and housecleaning notes[/h3]
A huge thank you to all of the communities who have provided their development support and input over the past few weeks ahead of our recent update. Update 1.05.1 also includes numerous bug fixes, including level selection/saving issues, and Steam achievement issues for some levels. We are always looking for feedback, bug reports, suggestions and idea, and we will continue to plan ahead for seasonal content this October and December!

notes.title: Forking Hell Launch Weekend
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Forking Hell will officially be released on July 1st, 2020! A celebration of the release will take place over the weekend of July 3rd-4th with broadcasts from the developers!

Forking Hell (do you like the pun?) is a 3D casual arcade-simulation game where the player guides a forklift vehicle around a virtual warehouse and completes customer orders over the working days. 

[b][u]Welcome to your new job[/u][/b]
You work in the Amazing Logistics warehouse, the robot powered e-commerce service of the future. Start by learning to drive a personalised forklift to get your driving licence. You will then begin your job as a forklift driver, collecting packages and delivering them to the truck through the working day. Be careful, the RUMBA-BOTS will zoom around the warehouse stocking up shelves and crashing into you, and could cause you to damage or break customer packages! You will work in different sections of the Amazing warehouse, retrieving all sorts of products including office supplies, home furniture and decorations.


[b][u]Single player experience[/u][/b]
Forking Hell is a wonderful little game to play solo as a way to escape reality and just chill out. The chaos of the RUMBA-BOTS combined with the semi-realistic physics helps give an arcade style to the simulation genre. The game is built with controller or keyboard/mouse input to support various play-styles and preferences.


[b][u]Based on a university prototype[/u][/b]
This product was originally planned and built as part of a university class by Louis Byers in 2020.
